item.title: MC1450134: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors
item.description: Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors starting early October 2026, allowing users to meet MFA requirements without additional passkeys. No configuration changes are needed, but organizations should update onboarding and MFA registration guidance accordingly.

item.title: RM571884: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

item.title: RM572673: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
item.description: Cloud Update is expanding rollback options for devices on Monthly Enterprise Channel. Administrators will be able to roll back devices to a release from two versions prior, with the latest available security updates for that release, and keep devices in the rolled-back state across subsequent releases until they are ready to resume updates. item.title: RM572682: Power Apps: Control information density in model-driven apps

item.title: RM570429: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey taking experience refinements
item.description: This feature is a collection of improvements including updates to the auto-save experience for comments, simplifying survey navigation through buttons by consolidating the "Skip" and "Done" buttons into a single "Next" button, and to give the survey taker greater control over question progression by refining the auto-scroll behavior when updating answers to questions.

item.title: RM569209: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: You will now be able to add multiple steps to your workflow when building one from scratch.

item.title: RM568067: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
item.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

item.title: RM566703: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

item.title: RM561327: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.

item.title: RM562340: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
item.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

item.title: RM562016: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
item.description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

item.title: RM571682: Power Apps: Modern, refreshed look for embedded model-driven apps
item.description: Extends the modern, refreshed look to embedded app experiences so model-driven app content retains consistent Fluent styling and interaction patterns when it appears inside another host. This was previously enabled for the monthly channel with the 2602.1 release and is now being enabled for the semiannual channel with the 2609.3 release.

item.title: RM558933: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
item.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

item.title: RM558286: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
item.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

item.title: RM558435: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
item.description: Administrators can choose a severity threshold and receive alerts when a new Edge update includes security fixes that meet or exceed that level, including zero day fixes. This helps organizations quickly identify updates that may require attention, while avoiding unnecessary notifications for routine releases.

item.title: RM501292: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): User can use Hubspot Connector in Researcher
item.description: The HubSpot connector allows users using the Researcher agent to be able to leverage 3rd party information from HubSpot to enrich generated responses with relevant information.

item.title: RM564617: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
item.description: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). New PowerShell cmdlets handle certificate import, registry configuration, private-key permissions, and validat...

item.title: RM571681: Power Apps: Modern, refreshed look for the mail app
item.description: Extends the Fluent-based modern, refreshed look for model-driven apps to the mail app, providing consistent controls, spacing, colors, and visual treatment when users work in that app. This was previously enabled for the monthly channel with the 2602.1 release and is now being enabled for the semiannual channel with the 2609.3 release.

item.title: RM570673: Work IQ: Retrieve
item.description: Enable agents to retrieve relevant Microsoft 365 content and context through Work IQ.

item.title: RM574094: Microsoft Teams: View files and conversations side by side
item.description: Review shared files without losing conversation context. When you open a PDF, Markdown, or HTML file from a Teams chat or channel message, the conversation appears alongside the file and takes you directly to where it was shared, allowing you to catch up on the discussion and respond without closing the file preview or switching back to chat.

item.title: RM574363: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling for legacy Office files
item.description: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt). Organizations can automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

item.title: RM574125: Visio: Desktop Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
item.description: The Microsoft Visio Desktop MCP Server enables compatible AI clients to connect with the Visio Desktop application to create, read, and update Visio diagrams using natural language. It runs locally on Windows and requires a licensed Visio Desktop application.

item.title: RM574124: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Enable MCP tools for POS returns
item.description: This feature provides reusable MCP tools for Store Commerce POS returns. These tools expose Commerce return capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and agent developers can use to build conversational or agentic return experiences.

item.title: RM574118: Dynamics 365 Finance: Improved planning writeback performance and flexibility
item.description: Business performance planning improves the performance and flexibility of writeback from the Matrix visual.

item.title: RM574117: Dynamics 365 Finance: Manage dimension security with Microsoft Entra groups
item.description: Administrators can now assign Microsoft Dataverse group teams backed by Microsoft Entra groups to Business performance planning dimension security groups. Previously, dimension security assignments were limited to individual users. The updated experience allows administrators to view and add eligible Entra group-backed teams alongside users, with separate membership information for each assignment type.

item.title: RM574116: Dynamics 365 Finance: Collaborative comments for planning cubes and dimensions
item.description: Create and manage contextual discussion threads directly on planning cubes and dimensions. Users can comment on dimension cells, detailed or aggregate cube cells, and reporting rows; reply to and mention colleagues; receive email notifications; and resolve or reactivate discussions. Public and private visibility options, together with an All Comments view, filters, export, and role-based management actions, support collaboration throughout the planning cycle.

item.title: RM574104: Power Apps: Manage model-driven app AI features from consolidated settings
item.description: Consolidated AI settings make it easier for makers and admins to find and manage AI capabilities for model-driven apps across two complementary surfaces.

item.title: RM573705: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Define custom scenarios for agent-generated supplier emails
item.description: Business end-users and buyers can define and maintain their own outbound follow-up scenarios and use them wherever built-in scenarios are used today:

item.title: RM573698: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
item.description: Shared mailbox users and delegates with read and manage (full access) and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in classic Outlook, when added as a resource.

item.title: RM573277: Power Pages: Create Power Pages SPA site from the Power Pages studio
item.description: Quickly get started with modern single-page application (SPA) development by creating a site directly from Power Pages Studio. Continue building and customizing your experience using your preferred development tools and frameworks.

item.title: RM570870: Work IQ: Microsoft IQ
item.description: Provide a unified intelligence layer that helps agents discover, reason over, and use organizational knowledge.

item.title: RM570868: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools
item.description: Enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.

item.title: RM570852: Work IQ: A2A and MCP elicitation
item.description: Enable A2A and MCP tasks to request missing information or authorization and then resume.

item.title: RM570851: Work IQ: A2A and MCP long running tasks
item.description: Enable durable long-running A2A and MCP tasks with progress tracking, later result retrieval, and cancellation.

item.description: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM573625: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD
item.description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD.

item.title: RM575287: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Admin Units Support for Copilot & Cowork DLP
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extending Administrative Units support to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork. This enables organizations to delegate management of supported Copilot DLP policies to administrators within their assigned Administrative Units, supporting regional, departmental, and regulatory boundaries without granting tenant-wide policy-management permissions. item.title: RM575298: SharePoint: Agent chat web part
item.description: This is a new web part available for modern page editors in SharePoint. The web part can be configured to use any M365 Copilot agent.

item.title: MC1326509: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection is releasing File Labeler and File Viewer apps for macOS to enable sensitivity labeling and protected file viewing, matching Windows capabilities. Public preview starts May 29, 2026; general rollout begins January 2027. Advanced label-based protection is not supported initially. No immediate action required.

item.title: MC1302906: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Schedule prompts in Agent Builder
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Agent Builder will support scheduled workflows to run prompts automatically on hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly cadences. Available worldwide by November 2026, this feature enables users to automate routine tasks per user, with workflows editable and enabled by default.

item.title: MC1506735: Microsoft Planner: AI-generated status reports in Planner Agent
item.description: Microsoft Planner now includes AI-generated status reports via Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, summarizing plan progress, risks, and next steps. Users with a Copilot license can customize and generate reports from accessible plan data. Rollout starts late October 2026, with no required user action.

item.title: MC1506734: Microsoft Teams: Video sharing from OneDrive in Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will soon allow organizers and producers to share videos directly from OneDrive during Teams events using "Manage what attendees see," enabling smoother, higher-quality playback without screen sharing or embedding in PowerPoint. Rollout begins November 2026, with no action required but recommended communication and preparation.

item.title: MC1506733: Action may be required: Review who can create agents in Microsoft Entra
item.description: Starting November 4, 2026, default users in Microsoft Entra can create agent blueprints unless administrators disable this via the "Users can create agent blueprints" setting. Admins can restrict this by toggling the setting to No in the Entra admin center before rollout completes in late November.

item.title: MC1506730: Classic Outlook for Windows: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates like improved icons, spacing, and alignment starting early November 2026, enhancing clarity and consistency without changing workflows. No admin action is needed; users and help desks should be informed of appearance changes. These updates do not replace the classic experience.

item.title: MC1506728: Microsoft Entra: Changes to AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager permission for agent identities
item.description: Starting November 4, Microsoft Entra will stop automatically granting the AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager permission to agent blueprints. Admin consent will be required for agents to create identities. This change, rolling out worldwide in November 2026, enhances control and auditability of agent identity creation.

item.title: MC1506727: Microsoft Agent 365: Expanded access to Microsoft agent usage and activity insights in Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: Microsoft is removing the Agent 365 license requirement for observability data of supported agents built by Microsoft or on Microsoft platforms, expanding access to usage and activity insights in the Microsoft 365 admin center starting late November 2026. Licensing for other Agent 365 features and third-party agents remains unchanged.

item.title: MC1440972: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Microsoft Edge is upgrading the Copilot new tab page to integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, web search, and work content in one experience with enhanced chat, compose features, suggested actions, and a refreshed design. Rollout begins late September 2026, requiring a Copilot license and admin enablement.

item.title: MC1381121: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Policy sync and device health AI skill
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention will introduce AI-powered policy sync and device health insights to improve troubleshooting and policy enforcement visibility. The rollout is paused; no immediate action is needed. The feature requires Security Copilot and enhances compliance monitoring with AI-driven root cause analysis and remediation recommendations.

item.title: MC1469329: Build apps in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork preview app-building with natural-language AI, enabling makers to create, test, and publish apps using organizational data and policies. Copilot Credits manage usage and billing. Admins control access and governance via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout started September 2026.

item.title: MC999442: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Retention based on “last accessed” for OneDrive and SharePoint files
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enable retention policies based on the "last accessed" date for Office files in OneDrive and SharePoint, starting preview in January 2027 and general availability by March 2027. This helps delete obsolete data and improve Microsoft 365 Copilot responses, with no admin action required before rollout.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable active Microsoft Entra users without Dataverse or Power Apps licenses as activity recipients. Created user records remain disabled and do not grant Dynamics 365 app access. This feature will reach public preview on October 15, 2026. How does this affect me? item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, enhancing visibility and providing AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins late October 2026 worldwide, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but communication to users is recommended.

item.title: MC1473155: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logging for role-based access control, adding two new audit operations to improve transparency and troubleshooting. The update, rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, requires no action and provides clearer visibility into access evaluations for administrators.

item.title: MC1484010: Microsoft Teams: Hide organizer names in calendar view on Teams Panels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Panels will add an admin setting to show or hide organizer names in Calendar View, configurable via the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or panel device. This feature, available with Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Spaces licenses, launches worldwide in early October 2026.

item.title: MC1473153: Microsoft Teams: New centralized experience for organizing important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a centralized resource management experience in chats and channels, allowing users to pin and organize resources below headers and access them on mobile. The "In this chat" and "In this channel" panes will be removed. Rollout begins late September 2026; no admin action required.

item.title: MC1437671: Microsoft Entra: Allow password change after secure sign-in with My Sign-Ins
item.description: Microsoft Entra will enable users to change passwords after secure sign-in using strong credentials (passkey, FIDO2, Windows Hello) without knowing the current password or using SSPR. This feature, disabled by default, requires admin activation and will roll out globally from October to November 2026.

item.description: Beginning November 9, 2026, we are introducing staged storage validation for supported Dynamics 365 applications. The change gives administrators clearer visibility into storage use, advance notice of potential restrictions, and several ways to remain within capacity, including removing unneeded data, adding capacity, or enabling pay-as-you-go for sandbox environments. item.title: MC1505610: Public CDN is becoming optional during Brand Center setup
item.description: Brand Center setup will no longer require enabling Public CDN by default, allowing organizations to use branding governance without it. Public CDN remains necessary for font features and must be explicitly enabled. This change rolls out worldwide in October 2026 with no action required unless fonts are used.

item.title: MC1505609: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Power Apps: Retirement of App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com by November 30, 2026, consolidating app creation into Copilot Cowork and Microsoft Copilot Studio. New app creation in retired platforms ends mid-October 2026. Organizations must migrate existing apps before retirement using upcoming in-product migration tools.

item.title: MC1505608: Audio overviews on PDF
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app's Audio Overviews on PDFs, which create AI-generated podcast-style summaries for commercial users, will be retired worldwide on October 30, 2026. After this date, the feature and previously generated audio overviews will no longer be available. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1505607: Outlook: Reply With a Template in Rules
item.description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules that auto-reply with saved templates, automating routine responses. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1505599: Microsoft Purview Audit: AuditLogQuery API generally available and Search-UnifiedAuditLog retiring
item.description: The Microsoft Graph AuditLogQuery API will be generally available in October 2026, replacing the Search-UnifiedAuditLog PowerShell cmdlet, which will retire on October 15, 2027. Organizations using Search-UnifiedAuditLog must migrate to the API to avoid disruptions, as future audit search enhancements will focus on the API.

item.title: RM570443: Microsoft Edge: v.155 - Tab organization enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Edge is expanding tab and Workspace organization capabilities to suggest groupings, names, visuals, and labels. Users can manage these experiences through the proposed “Let Microsoft Edge help keep your tabs organized” setting under Privacy, search, and services > Search and connected experiences; administrators can control them using the TabServicesEnabled policy.

item.title: RM575285: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Apply Purview network data security DLP policies to all websites, or all websites except specific cloud apps, through Entra GSA Internet Access integration
item.description: With this feature, admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites (.) or all websites except specific cloud apps, allowing them to apply protection to cloud apps and websites that are not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

item.title: RM575283: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
item.description: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

item.title: RM574123: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Unify product receipt and item requirement posting
item.description: This feature posts a purchase order product receipt and the consumption of its linked project item requirement in one transaction. It applies when automatic item consumption is enabled or when you select Consume immediately while posting the product receipt. Both updates succeed together, or the system rolls them both back when an error occurs. item.title: RM574105: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Integrate the Sales Development agent with Salesforce
item.description: Sales Development Agent now integrates with Salesforce, enabling organizations to use SDA with their existing Salesforce CRM. SDA can access leads, manage prospect records, log sales activities, and keep engagement actions—including qualification, disqualification, and ownership changes—connected to the CRM workflow. The integration uses Microsoft’s Salesforce Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to connect SDA with Salesforce.

item.description: Power Apps model-driven apps are now available as Business Apps in Work IQ. They can be accessed through the Work IQ (Preview) tool in Copilot Studio or through a natural-language chat experience powered by Work IQ MCP. In either experience, natural-language prompts let users list and read records or create, update, and delete them. For create and update, Work IQ maps supplied values to the appropriate app fields. item.title: RM570871: Work IQ: Updating documents in Office
item.description: Work IQ enables agents to create and edit Microsoft Office documents using organizational context, helping users produce and update content more efficiently.

item.title: RM570850: Work IQ: Upload
item.description: Enable agents to upload files and content to supported Microsoft 365 destinations.

item.title: RM574110: Microsoft Teams: Events now support up to 20,000 registrations, making it easier to reach and engage larger audiences at scale
item.description: Connect with more attendees than ever before with Teams Events, now supporting up to 20,000 registrations for organizers with valid Attendee packs.

item.title: RM570469: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
item.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

item.title: RM568364: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
